sequences.story: Lucia helps her mother clean up their dilapidated property, survives an alligator attack in the pool, deals with an armed gang confrontation, and ultimately uses an excavator to demolish the gang's house in retaliation.

A sustained 6-star police chase beginning inside a military base, breaking out onto country roads, crossing bridges towards Vice City, battling N.O.O.S.E. units and helicopters, and eventually culminating in a 'wasted' screen after extensive damage.

The player explores the docks, interacts with wildlife, strolls through downtown Vice City at sunset, visits clothing stores, hangs out in a club lounge, and ends up in an escalating police chase after stealing a tour bus.

Jason explores his home, talks to Lucia in the kitchen about their life together, drives his Vapid truck through the Keys while checking his phone and banking apps, and eventually arrives at The Rusty Anchor bar where Lucia joins him after work.
The sequence follows Lucia and Jason's confrontation with police, the ensuing chaotic escape in a red car, romantic dialogue inside the vehicle, and subsequent indoor domestic scenes.

The player attempts to evade Mariana County Sheriff boats and helicopters on the water, crashes into an island, steals a police boat, drives into downtown Vice-Dade County, enters a high-rise building, uses the elevator to escape to a parking garage, and tries to steal cars while police search the structure.

A continuous gameplay sequence featuring map navigation, driving a customized Sultan sedan across rural roads and sugarcane fields in Leonard County, discovering the Farm Fix Meth Lab on the map, and arriving at a trailer park to interact with a Vapid Marshall monster truck.

The player leaves an area on a scooter, switches to a pickup truck, visits Ammu-Nation to browse gear, drives across town causing a multi-car pileup with a boat trailer, and continues down the highway testing the vehicle handling and physics.
The player exits a safehouse, gets into an SUV, drives through suburban streets to a gas station convenience store, buys supplies and a beverage, and ends up in a street brawl with hostile locals.
The player breaches the airport security gate in a truck, evades ground patrols across the tarmac, boards a private jet, and takes off into the skies while police issue air support alerts.
